Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

declare
 temp boolean;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.donor is not null then

 end if;

 end ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_flag varchar2(1);
Begin
 
 /* Time zone changes */
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:donor_letters.generate_date,:donor_letters.generate_date);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:donor_letters.authorize_date,:donor_letters.authorize_date);
 end if;
 
if :donor_letters.donor_id is not null then
 BEGIN
 select initcap(first_name ||' '||last_name) 
 into :donor_letters.donor_name 
 from donors 
 where donor_id = :donor_letters.donor_id 
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- IM5237
 and rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 :donor_letters.donor_name := 'Not found';
 END;
end if;
if :donor_letters.generated_by is not null then
 BEGIN
 select substr(user_first_name,1,1)||'. '||initcap(user_last_name) 
 into :donor_letters.generated 
 from system_users
 where user_id = :donor_letters.generated_by
 and rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 :donor_letters.generated := 'Not found';
 END;
end if;
if :donor_letters.authorized_by is not null then
 BEGIN
 select substr(user_first_name,1,1)||'. '||initcap(user_last_name) 
 into :donor_letters.authorized 
 from system_users
 where user_id = :donor_letters.authorized_by
 and rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 :donor_letters.authorized := 'Not found';
 END;
end if;
if :donor_letters.last_reprinted_by is not null then
 BEGIN
 select substr(user_first_name,1,1)||'. '||initcap(user_last_name) 
 into :donor_letters.reprinted_by 
 from system_users
 where user_id = :donor_letters.last_reprinted_by
 and rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 :donor_letters.reprinted_by := 'Not found';
 END;
end if;

begin
 select intl_addr_flag into v_flag 
 from donor_addresses where donor_id = :donor_letters.donor_id;
 if v_flag = 'Y' then
 :donor_letters.address := intl_contact_info('ADDR',:donor_letters.donor_id,'ALL');
 :donor_letters.phone := intl_contact_info('HOME',:donor_letters.donor_id,'ALL');
 end if; 
 
exception when no_data_found then v_flag :='N';
 when others then handle_error; 
end; 
--message('My Flag is : '||v_flag);pause;
if NVL(v_flag,'N') <> 'Y' then
 BEGIN
 select initcap(street_name ||decode(suite_apt,null,', ', ', '||suite_apt||', ')||city)||' '
 ||state||' '||zip into :donor_letters.address
 from donor_addresses,valid_city_state
 where donor_id = :donor_letters.donor_id
 and donor_addresses.usps_id = valid_city_state.usps_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 END;
 BEGIN
 select h_area_code||'-'||substr(h_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(h_phone_no,4)
 into :donor_letters.phone
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :donor_letters.donor_id
 and h_area_code in (select code from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'AREAC');
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 END; 
end if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INTL_CONTACT_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION INTL_CONTACT_INFO (p_what IN varchar2,
 szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 v_return varchar2(300) :=Null;
 szAddress varchar2(300) := null;
 szHPhoneNumber varchar2(20) := null;
 szExtension varchar2(8) := null;
 szWPhoneNumber varchar2(20) := null;
Begin

 select intl_address_1||decode(intl_address_2,nvl(intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_2||decode(intl_address_3,nvl(intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_3||decode(intl_address_4,nvl(intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_4||decode(country_name,nvl(country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(intl_postal_code,nvl(intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE, 
 intl_home_phone_no, intl_work_phone_no, intl_work_phone_ext 
 Into szAddress, szHPhoneNumber, szWPhoneNumber,szExtension
 from donor_addresses 
 where donor_id = szDonorID
 and chapter_id = szChapterID 
 and address_type = 'RES'
 and intl_addr_flag = 'Y';

 
 if p_what = 'ADDR' then
 v_return := szAddress; 
 elsif p_what = 'HOME' then 
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber;
 elsif p_what = 'WORK' and szExtension is not null then
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber||'#'||szExtension; 
 elsif p_what = 'WORK' and szExtension is null then
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber;
 end if; 
 
 Return v_return;
 
Exception when others then handle_error; 
End;
